caption:
Baylor is expected to hire UTSA's Jeff Traylor as football coach

Traylor went 61-28 at UTSA, including three seasons with 10 wins. Baylor fired Dave Aranda in October. UTSA beat Tulsa 28-22 in San Antonio on Friday to improve to 10-2. ESPN's Pete Thamel reported the expected hire that day, citing sources. Traylor is a former Texas high school coach.

Reported by CBS Sports; ESPN.
